_about: Lane rules for this repo, checked on every pull request by tools/lanes/lane_guard.py (rules: jmax-workspace docs/handoffs/jay-rudd/RULES.md §3b). Jay's and Rudd's code lane is screens only (Jeff 2026-11-04): screen components (.tsx) and styles under app/, and tests. Every .ts module under app/ (including app/shared/, which holds sign-in, sessions and access), the API routes, the root layout, the sign-in and setup screens (app/login/, app/setup/, the shared-store sign-in and employee device sign-in setup), the theme, the database, migrations, worker and automation stay with the main build. Only branches matching side_prefix are limited. The examples are checked by tools/lanes/test_lane_guard.py.
